label: Fit shape
help: Mark triangles with the brush or smart select; the selection can change while the tool is open. The type is chosen automatically or set by hand; lock a value to fix it. Before OK, check that at least 95 % of the triangles are within the tolerance and that the snapped values are right. Robust ignores other surfaces that were selected by mistake.
selectionEmpty: Mark triangles with the brush or smart select (at least {{min}}).
selectionTooSmall_one: Selection too small: {{formatted}} triangle, at least {{min}}.
selectionTooSmall_other: Selection too small: {{formatted}} triangles, at least {{min}}.
robust: Robust (ignore other surfaces in the selection)
computedHint: Computed: the value comes from the scan. Click to fix it.
fixedHint: Fixed: the fit keeps this value. Click to release it.

result.poorFit: Only {{share}} % of the triangles are within the tolerance of ±{{tolerance}}. Check the selection or choose another type.
